class TestStatcoreAndRobust(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_mean_typical_values(self):
        result = statcore.mean([1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0])
        self.assertIsInstance(result, float)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result, 2.5)

    def test_mean_single_element(self):
        result = statcore.mean([7])
        self.assertIsInstance(result, float)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result, 7.0)

    def test_mean_negative_and_zero_values(self):
        result = statcore.mean([-2.0, 0.0, 2.0])
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result, 0.0)

    def test_mean_empty_raises_value_error(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            statcore.mean([])

    def test_trimmed_mean_typical(self):
        result = robust.trimmed_mean([1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 100.0], 0.2)
        self.assertIsInstance(result, float)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result, 3.0)

    def test_trimmed_mean_unsorted_input(self):
        values = [100.0, 2.0, 4.0, 1.0, 3.0]
        result = robust.trimmed_mean(values, 0.2)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result, 3.0)

    def test_trimmed_mean_zero_fraction(self):
        result = robust.trimmed_mean([1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 6.0], 0.0)
        self.assertIsInstance(result, float)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result, 3.0)

    def test_trimmed_mean_empty_raises_value_error(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            robust.trimmed_mean([], 0.1)

    def test_trimmed_mean_negative_fraction_raises_value_error(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            robust.trimmed_mean([1.0, 2.0, 3.0], -0.1)

    def test_trimmed_mean_half_or_greater_fraction_raises_value_error(self):

            robust.trimmed_mean([1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0], 0.5)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            robust.trimmed_mean([1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0], 0.8)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
